title: Stock adjustment concurrency regression
sourceVisibility: Internal repository. This is an anonymized verification summary, not a source-code export.
assertions: Exactly one adjustment succeeds; the other is rejected.
Only one stock ledger entry is written.
Transaction handlers for this product are serialized within the tested process.
Row-lock SQL is issued before the balance check.

verification.database: Mocked Prisma operations; no live database connection.

limitations: No live PostgreSQL contention test performed for this portfolio verification.
No multi-process or multi-instance behavior verified.
No production throughput or performance claim is made.
